steps.message: This project has a pom.xml and a standard src/main/java layout -- it's a Maven build, not an MSBuild-based .NET build, so MSBuild binlogs (/bl, -bl, the whole *.binlog mechanism) don't apply here at all; none of that tooling loads or reads a pom.xml. Getting a detailed diagnostic log for a slow or hanging Maven build is a Maven concern.

For verbose Maven diagnostics I'd suggest running mvn -X (or mvn --debug) for full debug-level output, and mvn -B --fail-at-end if you also want it to keep going past the first failing module. That's the Maven-native equivalent of what a binlog gives you for MSBuild, and it doesn't require anything MSBuild-specific.
